title: Kapıdaki dede

characters.GRANDPA: an old grandfather with white hair and a white mustache, wearing a dark green knitted vest and a grey flat cap
characters.BOY: a boy of about eight with short brown hair, wearing an orange jacket
characters.MAN: a young man of about twenty-five with short brown hair, wearing an orange jacket

scenes.text:
Deden seni yolcu ederken neden
köşeyi dönene kadar kapıda beklerdi?
scenes.prompt: On an autumn afternoon, {GRANDPA} stands at the wooden garden gate of a small old house, looking down the street, golden leaves falling around him.

scenes.text:
Sen arabaya biner,
hemen önüne dönerdin.
scenes.prompt: Seen through a car window on an autumn street, {BOY} sits in the back seat looking straight ahead, golden trees outside.

scenes.text:
O ise el sallamaya devam ederdi,
sen görmesen bile.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {GRANDPA} stands at the garden gate waving one hand, while a small car drives away down a leafy street in the distance.

scenes.text:
Çünkü belki dönüp bakarsın diye,
her seferinde biraz daha beklerdi.
scenes.prompt: At dusk, {GRANDPA} still stands alone at the garden gate, the street empty, a warm lamp glowing in the window of the house behind him, leaves drifting.

scenes.text:
Bu sefer köşeden önce dönüp el salla.
Bunu dedene gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset on a leafy street, {MAN} on the left turns around at the corner and waves, while far away on the right {GRANDPA} at the garden gate waves back, smiling, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Dönüp baktın mı?

O kapıda senin el sallamanı bekledi. 🤍

Bunu dedene gönder.
